additionalLiveSchemaObjects.name: workshop_email_address_limit
additionalLiveSchemaObjects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER workshop_email_address_limit BEFORE INSERT ON workshop_email_addresses
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workshop_email_addresses WHERE workshop_id=NEW.workshop_id AND email_key=NEW.email_key)
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM workshop_email_addresses WHERE workshop_id=NEW.workshop_id)>=10
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'workshop_email_address_limit'); END

CREATE TRIGGER `workshops_ignore_retired_insert`
BEFORE INSERT ON `workshops`
WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM `catalog_state`
  WHERE `key` = 'workshop-retired:' || NEW.id
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
END

additionalLiveSchemaObjects.name: suppress_removed_owner_hours
additionalLiveSchemaObjects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER suppress_removed_owner_hours AFTER UPDATE OF opening_hours ON workshops
WHEN OLD.opening_hours IS NOT NULL AND NEW.opening_hours IS NULL
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO workshop_opening_hours_imports(workshop_id,suppressed) VALUES(NEW.id,1)
 ON CONFLICT(workshop_id) DO UPDATE SET suppressed=1;
END
